description: How xf-ingest fills Canonical Track v2. The conversion itself is the goat-transformers canonical-track-v2 pack (goat-transformers/packs/canonical-track-v2/pack.def): every input format decodes to the shared model and the pack encodes the model as the canonical JSON. The kid adds the context below for keys a message does not carry; a value the message carries is never replaced.

context.value: the time the kid received the message

afterConversion.rule: a value outside the Billie track-class vocabulary is removed (the translator refuses it); each removed value is printed once

refused: A message that cannot supply trackId (uid), sourceId, trackGeneration, observedAt, latitude and longitude is refused by the pack with no-kind and counted; nothing is sent for it.
